source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
[Code the injury](https://www.bls.gov/iif/oshe-ills.htm).
    - [The recordable cases list provides definitions for the events](https://www.bls.gov/iif/oshe-caselist.htm) and [more definitions here](https://www.osha.gov/recordkeeping/tutorial/additional.html).
    - For all recordables, select the 10 parts of the employee as applicable to the incident ([source](https://www.bls.gov/iif/oshe-parts.htm)).
    - Record the occupational injury and/or illness using the [event/exposure table](https://www.bls.gov/iif/oshe-event.htm). Use this same table to select the [nature of injury](https://www.bls.gov/iif/oshe-nature
